biggest_catch: The referred friend must open a checking account, sign up for eStatements, and establish a monthly direct deposit of $250 or more within the first 60 days — the referral only pays if the friend meets all three criteria.
catches: The referred friend must be a first-time (new) member with Eagle and present a valid Eagle referral code.
The friend must open an Eagle checking account, sign up for eStatements, and establish a monthly direct deposit of $250 or more within the first 60 days.
Both parties earn $50 each only after the criteria are met; rewards are deposited after 60 days of account opening.
No limit to the number of referrals.
Eagle employees, volunteers, and their family members are ineligible.
Not valid with any other offers.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: Eagle Community Credit Union's official referral page (eaglecu.org) describes the 2026 Membership Referral Offer.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referring member earns $50 for each qualifying referral; the referred member also earns $50.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: the existing member shares their valid Eagle referral code (contact the credit union to verify the unique code) and the referred friend presents it when opening the account.

c4.evidence: Timing: rewards are deposited to the individual accounts after 60 days of account opening.

eligibility: Existing Eagle Community Credit Union members in good standing referring first-time new members.
notes: Eagle Community Credit Union (eaglecu.org, Lake Forest, CA). Offer runs through December 31, 2026. Catalog R0797 is a Colorado utility rebate with a similar name and is a different institution.
numeric_basis: Per-referral payout of $50.00; no stated referral cap.
payout_quote: Eagle CCU 2026 Membership Referral Offer: To refer and earn referral bonus, individual must be an existing Eagle CCU member in good standing and share their valid Eagle referral code, please contact the credit union prior to referral to verify unique referral code. Referral must be a first-time (NEW) member with Eagle and present a valid Eagle CCU referral code, open an Eagle CCU checking account, sign up for eStatements, and establish a monthly direct deposit of $250 or more to their new checking account within the first 60 days of account opening to qualify. If the criteria are met, the referring and referred member each earn $50 deposited to their individual accounts after 60 days of account opening. No limit to number of referrals.
payout_value_note: $50 per qualifying referral, paid to both parties.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Tax treatment not disclosed on the observed snippet.

s4.note: No limit to the number of referrals.

s5.note: 2026 Membership Referral Offer live on the institution's own domain, open through December 31, 2026.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: share your valid referral code and have the friend present it when opening.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: present a valid referral code, open a checking account, sign up for eStatements, and establish a monthly direct deposit of $250 or more within the first 60 days.

steps: Verify your unique Eagle referral code with the credit union.
Share the code with your friend.
Your friend opens a checking account as a first-time member, presents the code, enrolls in eStatements, and establishes a $250+/month direct deposit within 60 days.
You earn $50 after 60 days of account opening, with no referral limit.
timing: Rewards are deposited to the individual accounts after 60 days of account opening.
